_comment: The method → permission mapping, for the permissions that HAVE one.
motion-back (src/plugins/__fixtures__/); each side asserts its own copy.
Methods mapping to null are omitted on purpose. They need no permission, so
the two sides genuinely do not have to agree on them — and forcing them to
would make this fixture churn every time a convenience method is added.
What breaks if this drifts: the publish-time scanner infers which
permissions a package actually uses by matching these method names in its
source. A stale entry makes it report a permission as unused when it is
used, which sends a clean package to manual review; a missing entry makes
it miss a package calling something it never asked for.
